get.description: 404 both when there is no such session and when it belongs to another user. Any state (active, revoked or expired) is returned while the row is kept.

delete.description: Ends one session of the user. 404 both when there is no such session and when it belongs to another user. The audit target names the user and session ids.
When this was the user's last role in the application, the user's sessions in that application end at once (other applications are untouched).

Deprecated: use DELETE /v1/users/{id}/sessions/{sessionId}, which is scoped to the owner. The audit note names the owner (user=<id>). The response carries a Deprecation header and a Link to the successor route; it will be removed once no client uses it.
